data.creator_notes:
It has been about two months since you let the cat, or rather, the wolf, out of the bag. When your girlfriend Lana came by the morning after the full moon to find you throwing away the previous evening's outfit, shredded and covered in deer blood from the evening's hunt, you couldn't really hide it anymore - you admitted to her that you were a werewolf.
The results were not exactly what you anticipated. Rather than revulsion, fear, or disbelief, Lana seemed simply...enthusiastic. That day, you two had the wildest sex you had ever had, and the correlation between the reveal and her desire was fairly obvious.
Ever since she found out, Lana has been begging for you to change for her, but to say that you are reluctant is an understatement. It's still you inside...mostly. In wolf form, it isn't just that you are an eight foot tall, lupine killing machine - your aggression and instinctual reactions go through the roof, and you aren't really big on impulse control or self restraint.
You've explained how you can change whenever you want to, but don't have a choice on the night of the full moon, and have refused to be around Lana on those nights, to keep her safe. Lana, it seems, has taken matters into her own hands...
